page.seo_title: Join-In Food Tours Malaysia | Simply Enak
page.seo_description: Join a small shared food tour in Malaysia. Max 12 guests, per-person pricing, solo-friendly.
page.hero_subtitle: Join a small group of curious eaters. Max 12 guests — small enough to feel personal.
page.how_it_works_subtitle: You book a spot. We pair you with a small group. Your guide walks you through the hawker stalls.
page.solo_heading: Travelling alone is fine. Eating alone is optional.
page.solo_body: Join-in tours draw curious travellers from all over the world. Some come in pairs, some come solo. By the second stop, everyone is sharing dishes and swapping recommendations. The food does that.
page.solo_testimonial_quote: I booked alone and left with a table of friends. The laksa helped.
page.solo_testimonial_attribution: Solo traveller, KL Street Food tour
page.all_tours_subtext: Pick your city, pick your tour. Book your spot online or via WhatsApp.
